skills.name: Continuous Rates and Investment Differential Equations
skills.description: Formulating and solving separable or first-order differential equations for continuous compounding and continuous deposits/withdrawals.
question_forms: set up and solve a differential equation for continuous investments
determine the balance of an account with continuous interest and deposits

skills.name: Integration by Parts for Cyclic Integrals
skills.description: Evaluate integrals involving products of exponential and trigonometric functions by applying integration by parts repeatedly to set up and solve an algebraic equation for the unknown integral.
question_forms: find the antiderivative of an exponential times a sine or cosine function

skills.name: Partial Fraction Coefficients
skills.description: Determine the unknown constant coefficients in a partial fraction decomposition of a rational function with linear and repeated linear factors.
question_forms: find the constants in a given partial fraction decomposition
determine the partial fraction decomposition of a rational function

skills.name: Integer Root Test and Polynomial Factoring
skills.description: Identifying potential integer roots of a polynomial with integer coefficients and factoring the polynomial using root testing and coefficient matching or division.
question_forms: List all candidate integer roots of a polynomial and factor it completely

skills.name: Product Rule for Differentiation
skills.description: Compute the derivative of a product of two differentiable functions using the product rule.
question_forms: calculate the derivative of a product of two functions
